ranking_convention: docked ligands are fused by the frozen phi; ligands that never received a cell are ranked last (you cannot find what you did not dock)

policy_definitions.s1_width: one (train-best) receptor for min(B, N) ligands: the width limit
policy_definitions.s2_uniform: floor(B/N) receptors (train order) for every ligand; slack stays unspent
policy_definitions.s3_top*: stage 1: best receptor for all ligands; stage 2: extra receptor rounds on the top x% of stage-1 scores
policy_definitions.s4_scaffold*: stage 1: one representative per scaffold; stage 2: all receptors for the best x% of scaffolds by representative score
policy_definitions.s5_score_oracle: per-ligand upper bound: every ligand keeps its own best-k receptors (hidden matrix, no labels)
policy_definitions.s5_metric_oracle: cell-greedy oracle that maximises the held-out-fold metric (hidden matrix + fold labels; upper bound, computed only at greedy_budgets to bound the compute)

oracle.note: s5_metric_oracle is optional and NOT part of the default family: with the evaluation restricted to the held-out fold it degenerates to 'dock every cell of the fold' and costs ~0.37 s per greedy step; run it explicitly with --policies if a metric upper bound is wanted

gate_g2.width_locked_rule: at every depth budget the best policy is s1_width in all primary targets (fraction_width_locked = 1.0) -> the practical ceiling of ensemble docking is pinned
gate_g2.nontrivial_rule: some non-baseline policy, at the same budget and the same frozen phi, beats s1_width with mean_delta>0 and ci95_low>0 in >= min_targets primary targets

notes: E2 is an exploratory re-analysis of already-seen matrices (parent plan section 5.1).
Budget = docking jobs = (ligand, receptor) cells; the 600-ligand panel x 15-16 receptors is the library.
Policy parameters (receptor order, stage-1 ranking) use the training fold and revealed scores only; only s5_* may read the hidden matrix and are reported as upper bounds.
No new docking: every cell is a lookup in the existing dense primary matrix.

exploratory_analysis.note: descriptive deliverable of parent plan section 3 E2 (the allocation law); computed from the training fold only, reported as hypothesis generation, and excluded from the G2 decision

revision_notes: 2026-09-13 freeze before the full battery: G2 stability is evaluated per (policy, budget, phi) across primary targets only (no family-max mixing); fold pairing is by outer_fold id, not row order.
s5_metric_oracle stays optional and outside the default policy family (degenerate under the held-out-fold evaluation convention).
